narrative: Demand for PL1__M9ECABAB is smooth and approximately normally distributed with a mean of 1,218 units/day and a CV of 0.328, but exhibits a significant declining trend of approximately -30% over the observation period. Lead times are moderately variable (CV=0.586) with a structural shift from ~4-day to ~1-day lead times mid-period, requiring use of the 95th-percentile effective lead time of 4.30 days. The (r,Q) continuous-review policy is selected with safety stock of 2,744 units to achieve the 95% service level target, an EOQ-based order quantity of 5,784 units, and a reorder point of 7,983 units — all within the 9,304-unit storage constraint.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth, near-normal demand with stable positive non-zero fraction and moderate CV qualifies for classical continuous-review (r,Q). The EOQ balances ordering and holding costs optimally. Fixed order quantity simplifies SAP parameter maintenance.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity (9,304 units) is respected: SS(2,744) + OQ(5,784) = 8,528 units, leaving an 8.3% buffer. No capacity constraint binds in the recommended policy.
